maria (PM): Kickoff — want to propose a tiered pilot approach for DP/beta. High level: 1) Evaluation track (free, heavy feedback), 2) Pilot track (paid, SLA, integration support), 3) Private preview (limited features, security review). Thoughts?
ajohnson (PM): +1. Why tiered vs gating features by usage? Might help set expectations and support level.
sasha (PD): Agree. For Pilot track we need clear success criteria: throughput targets, error rate <1%, integration checklist done, NPS >= 6 on feature feedback.
nate (Eng): For throughput targets we should define seq len and qps. Recommend perf SLO: p95 latency < 350ms on 512 tokens for pilot customers.
leila (CS): From CS: require explicit engagement cadence: weekly async pulse + biweekly demo for first 8 weeks. Compensation: $5k credit or dedicated onboarding hours?
maria (PM): Good. Also propose screening rubric snippet:
```
Screening rubric: 
- Use case fit (0-3)
- Expected QPS/seq len
- Data sensitivity (public/confidential)
- Integration complexity (0-3)
- Commitment to feedback cadence (Y/N)
```
ajohnson (PM): can we add "willingness to run our eval suite" as checkbox? that's non-negotiable.
sasha (PD): Add quality gates: regression rate <= 1.5x baseline per eval, human-eval acceptance on 5 core prompts.
nate (Eng): Operational constraints: will assign 0.5 engineer for onboarding for Pilot track. For Dedicated/paying customers we need SLA doc — draft incoming.
leila (CS): Also need cancellation/exit criteria in contract: if partner doesn't respond to 3 successive requests, we pause and reopen pool.
maria (PM): Launch criteria draft: 3 Pilot customers signed, pass perf SLOs for 2 weeks, no showstopper bugs, docs + SDK examples updated.
dev-rel-bot: Reminder: uploaded onboarding checklist template to https://redwood.internal/onboarding-templates
ajohnson (PM): Next steps: Maria to update recruitment email, Sasha to append eval pass thresholds, Nate to sketch SLA bullets, Leila to draft engagement MOU. Review Thu 10am.
maria (PM): Assigned. I'll also propose compensation tiers for Pilot vs Evaluation in the email. :thumbsup:
leila (CS): Nice. Can we add a question in intake form: 'Who is decision owner for deployment?' saves us time.
sasha (PD): One more ask: include a short prompt set for each partner to validate domain-specific behavior early.
maria (PM): Great — will include. Thanks all.
